T:P1.1.text: Savers: Second Hand Used Clothing Thrift & Vintage Store

T:P1.2.text: With multiple thrift stores in the U.S., Canada, and Australia you're sure to find great deals on clothing, accessories, hard goods, electronics, books, home goods, and more.

T:P1.4.text: Join the Club Text BONUS to 53955

T:P1.5.text: Both coupons are valid for 14 days once received. See coupon for details. Both require consent to Super Savers Club® program terms and privacy policy. See savers.com/super-savers/program-terms for both program details. *For first-time signups with valid email only. Coupon will be emailed. **Valid for first-time text message subscribers only; available to existing Super Savers Club® members and new members joining by text message. Coupon will be texted. Standard message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.

T:P1.6.text: For nearly 70 years, our business has driven significant community and environmental impact.

T:P1.7.text: We pay our nonprofit partners for your stuff, helping them fund programs in your community.

T:P1.8.text: Your one-of-a-kind finds are given a second chance to be loved again by thrifters like you.

T:P1.9.text: Together, we champion reuse and keep millions of reusable items out of landfills every year.

T:P1.10.text: We can’t do it without you.

T:P2.2.text: Since our humble thrift shop beginnings, we've come a long way in the secondhand space.

T:P2.3.text: Committed to making secondhand second nature.

T:P2.4.text: Since our humble thrift shop beginnings, we’ve come a long way in the secondhand space. We’ve grown from a single shop to a global reuse champion—and it’s all because of you.

T:P2.5.text: It’s the thrill of finding “this is exactly what I need,” the “why not,” and “where’d you get that?!” It’s one-of-a-kind finds for one-of-a-kind people. It’s reusing, repurposing, and upcycling, helping save the planet while saving a few bucks. This is thrift.

T:P2.6.text: Thrift is what you make it. You’ve turned secondhand goods into first-rate fashion and made pre-loved looks feel pretty unbelievable. While we’re honored to fill our racks with one-of-a-kind finds, they don’t really come to life until you make them yours. So, thank you for shopping, styling, and redefining what it means to shop secondhand.

T:P2.7.text: We couldn’t be more Thrift Proud®—and hope you are, too.

T:P2.8.text: Back our first thrift shop called an old movie theater in San Francisco’s Mission District home. From day one, we gave shoppers what they were looking for: stylish finds at unbelievable savings.

T:P2.9.text: Since then, we’ve opened stores across the U.S., Canada, and Australia and have consistently partnered with local nonprofit organizations.

T:P2.10.text: We’ve chosen to keep our business model this way—to buy our supply from local nonprofits. But we didn’t stop there. We’ve also created a leading recycling and reuse program, where we keep millions of pounds of reusable items out of area landfills every year.

C:P1.2.text: We offer a variety of services to make your life a little easier

C:P1.3.text: By offering exceptional values on quality merchandise, EZCORP appeals to a growing segment of budget-conscious shoppers. Our sales reflect that.

C:P1.4.text: At EZCORP, we help customers turn their valuables into instant cash. We buy everything from gold and diamonds to electronics, tools, musical instruments and more.

C:P1.5.text: EZCORP provides a variety of quick, convenient and confidential ways to borrow money – helping millions meet their immediate financial needs every year.

C:P1.6.text: We have the right people in the right place at the right time, to lead the way today and to step into greater roles tomorrow.

C:P1.7.text: We simplify our approach to business by focusing on behaviors and actions that drive positive customer and business results.

C:P1.8.text: Since the day we opened our doors, our goal has been the same: to make our customers' lives easier. Our mission is to put the "reuse" in Reduce, Reuse, Recycle, and do good for the environment by extending the useful life of millions of items and strongly contributing to the circular economy.

C:P1.9.text: alone, EZCORP recycled more than 5.6 million pre-loved items across our family of brands. If everyone bought one pre-loved item instead of a new one, we would save our planet from billions of pounds of waste.

C:P2.2.text: Our Mission is to be the First and Best Choice for Customers' Short-term Cash Needs and Quality Pre-owned Goods.

C:P2.3.text: The most passionate and tenured teams in the industry

C:P2.4.text: A passion for pawnbroking and solving customer needs

C:P2.5.text: Significant and sustained adjustment of cost base through ongoing simplification

C:P2.6.text: Realize operational efficiency, bottom line growth and strong return on capital

C:P2.7.text: Broaden customer engagement to service more customers, more frequently in more locations

C:P2.8.text: Renewed focus on the unique and essential elements of our pawn business

C:P2.9.text: We are all leaders...At work and in the communities in which we live and serve

C:P2.10.text: Our customers are at the center of everything we do

C:P2.11.text: We are each responsible for our words, actions, results and outcomes

C:P2.12.text: We act with empathy, honesty and integrity

C:P2.13.text: We cultivate an environment that values belonging and fosters development for all

C:P2.14.text: We positively impact the environment through our extensive network of reCommerce retail outlets

C:P3.2.text: EZCORP provides customers the opportunity to convert merchandise they no longer need into instant cash. We buy quality used items ranging from gold and diamond jewelry to electronics, video games, musical instruments, tools, sporting goods, and more. We pride ourselves on fair and accurate appraisals. Quite simply, we help our customers get more money for their things.

C:P3.3.text: In today’s economy, a growing number of consumers demand value, and EZCORP delivers. We sell an array of quality used items at budget-friendly prices. Our selection of merchandise is wide and ever-changing and includes gold, jewelry, electronics, tools, sporting goods, luxury handbags, shoes & sneakers, musical equipment and much more!
